body: Merge-time finding (refresh attempt, not pushed): main already has the same even-odd fix, `bc5daa32d` (Refs #2849, `outer_fills`). A refresh that takes main's side leaves this PR with only its chord-bore test and its decision file; the six affected tests pass that way. The re-review should decide whether that test still adds coverage, or whether this PR closes as superseded by `bc5daa32d`.

Fix for the merge-time finding. New head: `c01305462`.

Finding: main already has the same even-odd fix (`bc5daa32d`, `outer_fills`).

What changed:
- I merged `upstream/main` into the branch with a merge commit. I did not rebase.
- The conflict in `connected_pieces` takes main's side: `outer_fills(region.loops())`. The PR code for this line is gone.
- The net diff against main now has two parts: the chord-bore pin and the decision file.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/2849-corner-cusp-loop.md` records the merge. It also adds "close as superseded" as an option for the re-review to decide.

Pin: `machining2d::unreached::law::a_chord_cusp_that_crosses_itself_does_not_stop_the_corner_check`.
- This test goes through `unreached_corners` and `unreached_corner_note` on a real bore less its swept area. Main's pin `a_micron_bow_tie_cusp_gives_its_lobes_and_no_error` tests `outer_fills` alone.
- Mutation check on the merged code: `Region::new` in `outer_fills` makes the pin fail. `Region::from_slices` makes it pass.

Gate:
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: green (`motion` lib, `app:adaptive_zero_margin_island`).
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: clean.

Please re-review. Decide if the chord-bore pin adds enough coverage to merge, or if this PR closes as superseded by `bc5daa32d`.

<!-- pr-reviewer: c01305462e0a169caf4d6b210226a8debfb57e89 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The chord-bore test adds useful coverage. It checks `unreached_corners` and `unreached_corner_note` with three generated bores. Main's bow-tie test checks `outer_fills` directly. Keep this test rather than close the PR as superseded.

Results merged with main, locally:
- Reviewed against current upstream `AGENTS.md` at `f036dddad`.
- The trial merge with `upstream/main` `f036dddad` was clean.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed. Motion lib: 491 passed, 10 ignored. `adaptive_zero_margin_island`: 4 passed.
- The new chord-bore test passed within motion lib.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: passed. The release build and both light tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main --dry-run`: selects all motion and app heavy targets, with 236 planned steps. This was a plan only. The heavy tests did not run.

Requested before merge:
1. `crates/motion/src/machining2d/unreached.rs:313` and the PR body's `Not exercised` section: supply the missing heavy-lane results. Current upstream law, `Heavy lanes at review`, requires the author to run reached heavy tests on the final head and name the lanes in the body. Run `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` locally. Record the results and resolve any failures before this PR is ready. The body explicitly says these lanes did not run. The passing quick and light gates do not replace them.

Extra suites run:
- No extra fixture or importer suites apply. The net diff changes no fixture, golden, or importer code.

Mutations and goldens:
- No mutations were run. The current net diff adds only a test and a decision record. It changes no production geometry, posting, simulation, gouge, or collision code. The even-odd implementation is already on main.
- No goldens moved. The author's mutation claim was not independently verified.

Notes:
- Update the title, opening description, and changelog text to describe the remaining regression coverage. The opening description still presents the implementation change as part of this PR. The later comment and decision record explain the actual scope.
- `Refs #2849` is appropriate for this partial work. The other defects on that issue remain open.
- No code defect was found in the added test. The missing heavy-lane evidence blocks readiness. The PR stays a draft with `needs-rework`.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: missing heavy-lane evidence and stale title, opening description, and changelog text.

- Heavy evidence: `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` completed all 236 steps in 44.2 minutes. The result is green. There were 100 passing tests, six expected known failures, and zero failed gate steps. The PR body names the lanes and expected failures.
- Scope: the title, opening description, and changelog now describe the chord-bore regression coverage. The production fix is already on main.

Pin: `machining2d::unreached::law::a_chord_cusp_that_crosses_itself_does_not_stop_the_corner_check`.
Replacing `Region::from_slices` with `Region::new` in `outer_fills` makes this pin fail with `loop crosses itself` (RED).
Restoring the exact original source makes it pass (GREEN: 1 passed).

`cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` is green: motion lib 491 passed, 10 ignored; app `adaptive_zero_margin_island` 4 passed.
`cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings` is clean.

Head: `c01305462e0a169caf4d6b210226a8debfb57e89` (unchanged).
This correction changes only the PR metadata and test evidence. No source changes or new commit were needed.

Please re-review.

Ready for the maintainer to merge.

This is a re-review of the same head. The later `Addressed` comment supplies the missing evidence. The earlier requested change is met.

What looks good:
- The test covers `unreached_corners` and `unreached_corner_note` with three generated bores. It adds coverage beyond main's direct `outer_fills` test.
- The title, opening description, and changelog now describe the remaining regression coverage.
- `Refs #2849` keeps the other defects open. The decision record explains the partial scope and the merge with main.

Results merged with main, locally:
- Checked the laws in upstream main's current `AGENTS.md` at `5e76e6a14b366c510858bbbf660c06ca013c34d4`.
- The trial merge with that main commit was clean. Checks ran in `.claude/worktrees/review-2850`, with its own target directory. No GitHub runner was used.
- `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main`: passed, two steps. Motion lib: 491 passed, 10 ignored. App `adaptive_zero_margin_island`: 4 passed.
- The new `a_chord_cusp_that_crosses_itself_does_not_stop_the_corner_check` test passed within motion lib.
- `cargo xtask gate light`: passed, three steps. The motion release build (`--no-run`) and both light tests passed.
- `cargo clippy -p camcraft-motion --all-targets -- -D warnings`: passed.
- Cargo reported an existing unused workspace dependency warning for `truck-polymesh`. Clippy reported no code warning.

Heavy lanes and results:
- The author reports `cargo xtask gate heavy --base upstream/main` on this exact head, against base `60cb97a0b`. It completed 236 steps in 44.2 minutes, with zero failed steps.
- Motion heavy: 57 passed and two expected known failures. App heavy: 43 passed and four expected known failures.
- Motion targets with passing heavy tests: `lib`, `adaptive_hsm`, `adaptive_troch_neck`, `finish3d`, `finish3d_gaplink`, `flow`, `lead_room`, `offset_shells`, `pivot5d`, `pocket3d_hsm`, `rotary_adaptive`.
- App targets with passing heavy tests: `adaptive_fig8_crossing`, `adaptive_pinch`, `carried_engine_agreement`, `example_catalog`, `feature_pick_wire`, `import_solidcraft`, `large_models`, `lathe_field_sim`, `lathe_workholding_kinds`, `operations`, `pick_agnostic`, `pocket3d_hsm`, `rotary_field_parity`, `shared_face_bodies_finish`, `shoulder_adaptive`, `stock_engine_agreement`, `stock_field_cost`, `stock_play_precalc`, `verify`, `whole_model_pocket`.
- The six expected failures are the tracked #1950 and #2849 tests named in the PR body. The gate checked their expected failures. They remain open defects.
- These heavy results are author-supplied evidence. I did not repeat the heavy run. The body now names the lanes and results required by `Heavy lanes at review`.

Extra suites run:
- None required by the fixture and importer selection rules. The net diff changes no fixture, golden, or importer code.

Mutations and goldens:
- No mutations were run in this review. The net diff adds only a test and a decision record. It changes no production geometry, posting, stock simulation, gouge check, or collision check.
- The author reports RED with `Region::new` in `outer_fills`, then GREEN after restoration. I did not independently verify that mutation.
- No goldens moved. No UI code changed, so before/after screenshots are not required.

Requested before merge: none. The earlier heavy-evidence finding and description notes are resolved. This clean review replaces the earlier blocking verdict for this head.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
